messages:
deploy-bot: Auto-pausing deploy slot #512 for service="inference-api" due to linked incident INC-2026-042 (kv-cache evictions). Current rollout halted. Pinned candidate: v2.3.1. Will not auto-retry. See https://deploys.redwood.internal/slot/512

maria: ugh. which customers are impacted? any live traffic dropping?

alex: short answer: a subset of heavy-context workloads in eu-west are seeing token stalls, hitting kv cache pressure. metrics -> dash/kv-evict spikes. no DB errors.

jordan: suggest we keep the pin and reschedule remainder to maintenance window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. canary already partially rolled (20%). don't rollback unless we see error-rate uptick.

samir: +1 to pin. ops, can you confirm whether autoscaling is throttled? we might need to disable rolling-burst to avoid queueing.

ops-bot: Autoscaling: active. Recent throttles: 3 events in last 6m. Escalation notified to @irene and oncall. Incident channel: #inc-2026-042.

irene: I'll take oncall lead. plan: 1) keep slot pinned to v2.3.1 2) cancel next two rollout waves 3) run targeted canary rollback on 512 if error rate > 5% or p99 latency > 2s for 3m. assigning @alex to run the rollback checklist if needed.

alex: copying checklist here for quick ops: ```
# rollback checklist
- kubectl drain --selector=deploy-slot=512 --ignore-daemonsets
- deploy rollback inference-api --to v2.3.0 --slot 512
- monitor: p50/p95/p99, 5xxs, kv-evicts
- notify customers via status page
```

maria: will update the release notes & customer comms draft: "We paused the deployment for additional validation after an internal incident; affected traffic has degraded for some large-context workloads; migrating back to v2.3.0 is a contingency."

jordan: can we also add a note to the console that the version is pinned and will not auto-promote until ops clears? reduces accidental retries.

samir: command to pin if someone needs it: `deploy pin inference-api v2.3.1 --slot 512 --reason "INC-2026-042"`

ops-bot: Action items created: OP-4272 (pin slot), OP-4273 (cancel waves), OP-4274 (monitoring alert updates). ETA for reschedule: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC (tentative).

irene: assigning owner for the reschedule: @maria to draft the reschedule note and @jordan to coordinate the new deployment window with release calendar. I'll keep watch - will call rollback if thresholds hit.

maria: noted. will post updated release calendar entry and slack ping when reschedule is locked. :thumbsup:

jordan: once we lock, update deploybot with: `deploy reschedule --slot 512 --window "2026-03-21T02:00:00Z/2026-03-21T04:00:00Z"`

alex: standing by to run the rollback steps if we breach.

deploy-bot: Slot #512 remains paused. No auto-retries. Manual actions required to resume.
